n84d4cc7409.headline: Komárek Discovered Oil Worth Billions in South Moravia. Municipalities and the State Will Profit from Extraction | Aktuálně.cz
n84d4cc7409.summary: The mining company MND, owned by billionaire Karel Komárek, increased its oil reserves by a quarter due to a newly discovered deposit in South Moravia.
n84d4cc7409.why: MND is a significant energy company in the Czech Republic, and increased oil reserves can impact local energy supply and economic activity.
